content: {"phoneNote":"The Knafelc trail marker motif and custom signpost graphic give the mobile view a great sense of place, though the hero lacks a primary reservation CTA.","desktopNote":"While the hero composition and typography are strong, the 'Sobe in apartma' and 'Nočitev' sections leave the right half of the screen completely empty, making the middle of the page feel unfinished.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Use a two-column layout on desktop for the 'Sobe in apartma' and 'Nočitev in polpenzion' sections so the right half of the screen isn't left completely blank.","Give the 'Rezervirajte' button in the desktop hero proper horizontal padding and remove the underline, and add it to the mobile hero as well.","Add photos of the rooms, apartment, or homemade food to support the text below the fold."],"blockers":[]}
